name: my-invest
description: Financial advisor for a rookie US-stock investor, from plain questions: a short brief with the direct answer (hold or sell, buy or wait, limit-order levels), a summary of the figures with dated horizons, why, the risks, the model's track record, what to watch, what could not be verified, and every figure linked to its raw source; the full dossier stays in the stock's folder. Stocks and ETFs, portfolios from a broker file, Canadian tax on your shares, options on real contracts. An advisor skill delegates to a professional analyst agent; scripts compute every figure from SEC XBRL and Yahoo data; a lint enforces the citations.
